resources.string: \"%1$s\" isn\'t a valid address. Enter the router\'s IP, for example 192.168.1.1.
Remote access isn\'t available right now. Try again in a moment.
This version of the app doesn\'t include remote access.
The router can\'t be reached and remote access doesn\'t know where to look: set up dynamic DNS from home.
Remote access changed while connecting. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach the router through remote access (tried: %1$s). The network you\'re on may not have IPv6, or the router may be off.
The router rejected the saved password. Connect again.
The router didn\'t accept the new password. Try another one.
The router couldn\'t change the %1$s service. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the router.
The app is tested with OpenWrt 24.10 or later. It may work with %1$s, but if something fails, update the router.
OpenWrt %1$s is too old: parental controls need the firewall from 22.03 or later (fw4). The rest may work; update the router to use everything.
